def calculate_max_sum(S):
    N = len(S)
    # DP[i] stores the maximum sum of an allowed subsequence ending at index i (1-indexed)
    # We use 0-indexing for implementation, so DP[i] ends at S[i].
    DP_max = [S[0]] * N

    for i in range(1, N):
        s_i = S[i]

        # Max sum calculation
        prev_max = 0
        if i >= 1:
            prev_max = max(prev_max, DP_max[i-1])
        if i >= 2:
            prev_max = max(prev_max, DP_max[i-2])
        DP_max[i] = s_i + prev_max

        # Min sum calculation
        prev_min = 0
        if i >= 1:
            prev_min = min(prev_min, DP_min[i-1])
        if i >= 2:

        DP_min[i] = s_i + prev_min
        
    max_M = max(DP_max)
    min_m = min(DP_min)
    
    return max(max_M, abs(min_m))
